scope: Additive current Revenge Tower L1-L2, Supercharge and stage-evidence record; no unsourced stage actor is enabled.
game_version: Frozen payload 62b019df supplies L1-L2, Supercharge and stage tables; the official 2026-01-28 maintenance changes current stage thresholds and final-stage cadence.

sources.title: TOWN HALL 18 Crash Lands! - Update
sources.limitations: Confirms TH18, activation progression at 5/20/40 at launch, and that power and hitpoints increase; it does not give magnitudes, destroyed-building accounting, targets, attack values or tick ordering.

sources.title: Changes coming to Ranked Mode & League Modifiers!
sources.limitations: Changes the third and fourth activation thresholds from 20/40 to 25/50, slows the final attack to 350 ms and reports a DPS reduction up to 119, without full per-stage replacement values or lifecycle ordering.

sources.title: Revenge Tower
sources.limitations: Reports stage attack values, 11-tile range, air/ground targets, stage-2/3 bounce descriptions and Supercharge values, but has no immutable client build, replay trace, exact health boost or deterministic stage/collision contract.

sources.title: Revenge Tower payload
sources.limitations: Pins L1-L2 and Supercharge values plus the stage mode table, but predates the January 2026 balance and carries no explicit state-machine lifecycle.

missing: exact health increase by level/stage despite primary claim
definition and same-tick accounting of destroyed buildings
stage transition, cooldown and target retention

partial_mechanics_contract.note: Fandom supplies the numerical mode observations; exact health boosts conflict with its unchanged table and are not guessed.

support.note: No Core, Headless, Viewer or RL behavior proxy is enabled until the future-affecting stage contract is reproducible.

conclusion: Revenge Tower L1-L2, Supercharge and current stage evidence are hash-pinned data only. Its destructive-stage and multi-bounce Core behavior remains intentionally unmaterialized because primary health growth and the deterministic stage lifecycle are not published.
